poc_retest_results.title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA/IDOR) on Student Records

version_0_behavior.result: Parent token successfully retrieved unrelated student record (cross-tenant access).

version_2_behavior.response_message: Access Denied: You are not authorized to view another student's records.

poc_retest_results.title: Public QR Dynamic Badge Sensitive PII Leakage

version_0_behavior.result: Public unauthenticated QR scan returned 12-digit Aadhaar, residential address, parent phone, and exam marks.

version_2_behavior.response_dto: Sanitized Public Verification DTO (Photo, Full Name, Student ID, Class, Status)
version_2_behavior.privacy_guarantee: Aadhaar, home address, and academic grades stripped under DPDP Act 2023 compliance.
version_2_behavior.result: Data Minimization DTO active; sensitive PII redacted from public view.

poc_retest_results.title: Hardcoded JWT Fallback Secret Token Forgery

version_0_behavior.result: Offline-forged JWT signed with static fallback key 'secret' accepted as Administrator.

version_2_behavior.result: Hardcoded fallbacks eliminated; server startup aborted if default key used; 256-bit CSPRNG key in .env invalidates forged token.

version_0_behavior.result: Parent token successfully retrieved entire class grade sheet, marks, and peer rankings.

version_2_behavior.response_message: Access Denied: User role 'parent' is not authorized to access this route.

poc_retest_results.title: Insecure File Upload via Client MIME Type Spoofing

version_0_behavior.result: Malicious PHP script disguised as 'avatar.png' with Content-Type: image/png stored on disk.

version_2_behavior.response_message: Security Validation Failed: Uploaded file does not contain valid image binary magic bytes.
version_2_behavior.result: Native Buffer header magic-byte inspection (JPEG/PNG/WebP) detected spoofed payload and unlinked file immediately.

poc_retest_results.title: Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) & Query Syntax Crash

version_0_behavior.result: Unterminated regex group '(' crashed Node.js process with unhandled SyntaxError.

version_2_behavior.result: escapeRegex utility safely sanitized metacharacters; query executed as literal string in < 10 ms with 0 records returned.
